title.narrative: Togo Social Assistance Transformation for Resilience Program

description.narrative: The Program Development Objective is to “increase coverage of safety nets program and strengthen interoperable delivery systems”.

The development objective of the Social Assistance Transformation for Resilience Program for Togo is to increase coverage of safety nets program and strengthen interoperable delivery systems. The government's program (PNPSNC) lays the foundations for a strategic vision that rationalizes noncontributory social protection in Togo. The objective is to improve the socio-economic conditions of poor and vulnerable households while reducing gender inequalities, within a framework of consolidation and innovation of non-contributory social protection in Togo. It intends to address the challenges of institutional coordination, insufficient financing and coverage, regressive targeting, and inefficient interventions by reconfiguring existing initiatives along 4 axes.

title.narrative: IR 2.3: Payments Bridge and Multi-program/multi-provider payments platform is set up

baseline.value: Novissi model 1 and 2, and FSB by Novissi have mobile money payment capabilities.

target.value: A multi-program/multi provider payments platform is set up to serve as (i) a common infrastructure for end-to-end digital processing of bulk payment instructions that can be used by social protection programs to electronically disburse social benefit payments using the eID numbers as the financial addresses of beneficiaries through an eID mapper; and (ii) an interoperable payments network that allows beneficiaries to withdraw their social benefits through cash-out agents via online biometric authentication of the eID system.

actual.value: Novissi model 1 and 2, and FSB by Novissi have mobile money payment capabilities.

actual.value: Togo eID system was soft launched on Nov 27, 2023. The dynamic social registry (RSPM) software development is 75% complete, financed by WURI program.
